meta.freeze_procedure: 1. expand to 40-60 atomic predictions whose quantity paths all exist in a Phase 1 results.json of the development set; 2. set meta.status = prospective; 3. artifact-signals ledger hash --stamp; 4. git tag + OSF deposit of file and hash; 5. only then run any model on a test-set benchmark. Until step 2 this file scores as retrospective.
meta.quantities: results[benchmark][intervention][quantity]; *.delta = after - before on the evaluation split
meta.voiding_rule: a prediction is voided, not scored, when its intervention fails the invariance check (cross-model difficulty agreement on survivors < 0.6)
